did_you_know.text: Did you know? Chapter 1 of 1 Chronicles begins with Adam and continues through Seth, Enosh, and subsequent generations to Noah and his sons.
Did you know? Nimrod is mentioned as the first to become a mighty man on earth, and he appears among the descendants of Cush, the son of Ham.
Did you know? The passage states that the Philistines came from the Casluhites, in the list of the descendants of Mizraim, the son of Ham.
Did you know? Eber had two sons: Peleg and Joktan. Peleg’s name is explained by the statement that in his days the earth was divided.
Did you know? The chapter records Abram’s name change: “Abram, that is, Abraham.”
Did you know? Nebaioth is mentioned as Ishmael’s firstborn, followed by the names of Ishmael’s other sons.
Did you know? Keturah is described as Abraham’s concubine, and she bore him six sons, including Midian.
Did you know? The sons of Isaac mentioned in the chapter are Esau and Israel; the chapter then continues by listing Esau’s descendants.
Did you know? The chapter presents a succession of kings of Edom and emphasizes that they ruled in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites.
Did you know? After the list of Edomite kings, the chapter gives a list of Edomite chiefs, including leaders such as Timna, Kenaz, Teman, and Magdiel.
